---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/publication_artifacts.R"))
begin_artifact_render("clin_effect_table_s2")
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03"),
  funs = c("dag_helpers", "assoc_tests", "cox_extract", "tlr_landmark",
           "dag_association_tests", "supp_table_labels", "supp_table_s2"),
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "dagitty", "survival",
               "coxphf", "logistf", "coin"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)

# The edge list is derived from the canonical `dag` object (dag_helpers.R) by
# dag_association_tests.R, so this table always tests the graph shown in the
# DAG figure (issue #155). The week-9 landmark PFS cohort, built from the
# TLR-classified patients of the complete-case cohort (issue #184), is used for
# TLR -> PFS and a time-dependent progression indicator for PFS -> OS.
dd <- prepare_dag_data(data, landmark = "week9")
```

```{r run-tests, include=FALSE}
edge_results <- run_dag_edge_tests(dag, dd)
# Adjusted primary model of the main text, refitted for the reconciliation
# footnote (Firth Cox via fit_firth_cox(); issue #184).
adj_results <- run_adjusted_interaction_models(dd)

s2 <- build_supp_table_s2(edge_results, adj_results, dd)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(s2$table,
      caption = "Table S2. Bivariate association tests (direct edges of the assumed causal graph)",
      format = "html", row.names = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) |>
  footnote(general = s2$footnotes, general_title = "Notes: ")
```

```{r save-csv, include=FALSE}
write_artifact_csv(s2$table, file = here("outputs", "tables", "clin_effect_table_s2.csv"),
                   row.names = FALSE)
write_artifact_csv(s2$raw, file = here("outputs", "tables", "clin_effect_table_s2_raw.csv"),
                   row.names = FALSE)
```

Table saved to `outputs/tables/clin_effect_table_s2.csv`; unformatted values (estimates, intervals, p-values) in `outputs/tables/clin_effect_table_s2_raw.csv`.

```{r artifact-manifest, include=FALSE}
finish_artifact_render()
```
